Dream 2026-11-22 linked 2 vignettes from 2 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-11-06 · touches · "I prefer a federated model rather that scales in a fractal way rather than centralising" (Vignette 2026-11-06: encryption and access control are a multi-repo layer; signed writes, split and merge with a recorded home; a shared organisational memory)
- 2026-11-07 · touches · "We need the groups to host their own infrastructure" (Nearby AI needs communities capable of maintenance: muDemocracy for governing, SRS and the relay for owning data, the essay editor for safe individual use; "dumb AI" is the right level of intelligence in the right place, "cybernetic AI" is fractal feedback, VSM (2026-11-07))
